subject: Vendor onboarding: Sparrow Health — banking proof & remittance format
messages:
From: Maya Torres <maya@bankproofs.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: accounts@sparrowhealth.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sparrow Health — bank letter & W-9 (attached)

Hi Olga,

Attached are the bank letter and signed W-9 for Sparrow Health. The bank letter confirms the account and routing for ACH credits and includes a bank contact should you need a verification call. We also included a short CSV that maps their PO prefix to the remittance string they prefer.

Micro-deposit testing: Sparrow asked that you initiate two micro-deposits to the account so they can confirm ownership before the first live payout. Amounts will be small (e.g., $0.12 and $0.34).

Files attached: sparrow_bank_letter.pdf, sparrow_w9_signed.pdf, sparrow_po_map.csv

Let me know if you need anything else on the bankproof side.

Thanks,
Maya Torres
BankProofs.io — Client Success

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood-inference.com>
To: accounts@sparrowhealth.com, Maya Torres <maya@bankproofs.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sparrow Health — bank letter & W-9 (attached)

Thanks Maya — received and uploaded to the vendor record.

Hi Sparrow accounts team,

Quick next steps from Redwood:
- We will run the two micro-deposits today (expected to land in 1–2 business days).
- Please confirm the two amounts once you see them and reply to this thread with the confirmation. That will complete the bank ownership check.
- Can you confirm the PO number format you will send on invoices? We need to map PO prefix to the remittance string in our payops system. The attached CSV suggests "SPH-" as the PO prefix and a remittance string of "Sparrow|SPH|acct-88421" — please confirm or provide the exact field you want passed through.

Jordan / Ben — looping you in so FinOps can schedule the first test run and map the PO field to invoicing. Once micro-deposits are confirmed we will promote the account to live.

Olga Petrov
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood-inference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood-inference.com>, accounts@sparrowhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow Health — bank letter & W-9 (attached)

Olga / Sparrow —

Ben and I reviewed the CSV mapping and prepped a PO-to-remit rule. A few notes:
- PO mapping will write the remittance string into field: remit_instruction (format: "PO|Invoice|Memo").
- For Sparrow we propose: "SPH-" -> "Sparrow Health|{invoice}|PO:{po_number}". This means invoices with PO SPH-12345 will show a remit instruction like: "Sparrow Health|INV-2026-045|PO:SPH-12345".
- Compliance: W-9 verified. Bank letter scanned and stored to the vendor profile.

Priyom — once Sparrow confirms micro-deposit amounts, please run the ACH test and flag this account for production. Also add the PO prefix mapping (SPH-) to the payops mapping table.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
FinOps Lead

From: accounts@sparrowhealth.com <accounts@sparrowhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood-inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Maya Torres <maya@bankproofs.io>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow Health — bank letter & W-9 (attached)

Thanks — we received the micro-deposits this morning. Amounts: $0.12 and $0.34.

Confirmation of PO format: we send PO numbers in the header as "SPH-xxxxx" and would like the remittance field to include our vendor identifier. The suggested template from Jordan works for us. Please proceed with the ACH test and set the account live after validation.

Attachments: sparrow_w9_signed.pdf (signed), sparrow_bank_letter.pdf (bank scan)

Best,
Camille Ramirez
Accounts Payable
Sparrow Health
